nom: Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

avis.texte: It frees my pores of impurities that I otherwise see after applying foundation.

I love this scrub! I have very sensitive skin and only recently did I start scrubbinh my face 1x a week, my biggest concern was preventing breakouts which this product does. What I didn't expect is how smooth and flawless my nose would look! 10/10 product and very easy to apply, I love the sensation when it dries out as well. So far it has never made my face irritated so I am very very happy!

Ive used this mask off and on but only recently started using it consistently 1-2 times a week. It really evens my skin tone and makes it look so clean afterwards. I feel bad for the people that its make their skin turn pink or red. I use the checks and balances cleanser and then the mask. I make sure to wash off any make up first so there are no weird chemical reactions on my skin. Im able to let the mask sit and dry on my skin while I read a chapter or 2 of my book and then I wash it off and use the mega mushroom moisturizer! So fresh and so clean!

avis.titre: Product Changed from Charcoal to Clear Sudsy Mask?
avis.texte: I have used this wonderful mask for at least 30 years with excellent results. I just bought this one at local store. Not sure if I got a tampered product or they changed the formula - it is no longer charcoal gray - its a clear goo. Nothing on label says its new or changed. When I washed it off, the water was sudsy. Don't know what to think of the situation but it is going back. Why do companies feel the need to change the formulas of their proven winners? And how are you to tell if the mask is dried since its clear?

I was excited to try this but within 2 minutes of having the mask on my face, my skin started burning. I kept it on a few more minutes thinking it was probably just drying on my skin, but I was wrong. When I washed it off my face was red with even redder dots all over. I have sensitive skin, but have never had issues with the brand in the past. Time to look for another…

avis.titre: The only clay mask that works for me
avis.texte: I've used this mask on and off for over 10 years. I shop around for others sometimes because this one is kind of expensive. Lately I've been trying others that have a similar price point though and even they can't compare. I have super oily skin and large pores and this mask is the best thing short of a professional chemical peel that I've found to keep my pores clear. I've tried so many other hyped up clay masks and none of them do much of anything but with this one I can see a difference immediately after washing it off. I leave it on for as long as I can stand it, sometime even overnight which maybe is not recommended but for me it works. I'm going to stop wasting my money on other clay masks and just stick with this one from now on even if the price tag is a bit painful.

I am in my mid twenties and have struggled with acne for about 15 years or so. Additionally, I have large pores, uneveness, redness, oily, sensitive skin, just about everything you can put into a skin type. I've tried every solution under the sun, serums, creams, spot treatments, you name it, and NOTHING has cleared my skin more than this product. I bought it as a fun Valentine's spa date night idea and it's genuinely become a holy grail staple in my skincare routine (which is not extensive btw, I use the mask 1-2 times/week and pair with my go to moisturizer. simple but effective!) I leave the mask on for 15-20 min and gently wipe off with a slightly damp washcloth and immediately can tell the difference. My skin glows, my pores feel tight and clean. The following morning I'll notice my breakouts healing. It's even helped with toning down redness and existing acne scars. I can't say enough good things about this product - I've been really insecure about my skin for quite some time, especially as a lady in her mid twenties still struggling with acne. In just 2 weeks, this product has made a noticeable difference on my skin and my confidence is through the roof. Highly, highly recommend. If you are struggling with the price, know that a little goes a long way, and once a week is still enough for a noticeable difference!

avis.titre: Works for mature and teen skin!
avis.texte: I'm 43 with an oily T zone and large pores on my nose. Hereditary, sadly. I've been embarassed by my large pores for decades. My kiddo is 16 typical combo teen skin. Breakouts but nothing cystic. Shes good about being consistent with skin care. I didnt expect to love this mask as much as i do. It's much less messy than other clay masks and dries faster. My pores are visibly clearer and smaller snd my skin smoother after use every single time. My kiddo uses it and it smooths her texture and helps draw the ick out for her as well. The only drawback is price but i find tubes on sale here and there and it's so worth it. I use 2-3 times a week. She only needs it once a week. We love this mask!!
This product is amazing. Saw results in two uses. Skin feels tighter. Pores reduced in appearance. I'm going to use once a week. Hooked for sure. Doesn't take much product either to apply.
My skin feels calm, balanced, and refreshed after use. No irritation. Easy to apply and remove.
I like it, it cleans my skin well. Overall a good product. I do dislike how messy it is when washing off and sometimes even have trouble getting it all off my face. Takes longer than id like.
Noticeable difference in complexion after one use! Really impressed with the results.

I've been using this charcoal mask for 8 years and when I got my last shipment… I thought I purchased the small one by mistake. I checked the website to be sure, and nope. I noticed the increase in price from $26 to $35, but they ALSO reduced the size from 3.4oz to 2.5oz. I did the math, it's nearly double the price per ounce.
This is my fav mask to clear pores and reduce their size. A little tingly when it goes on which feels refreshing. Rinses well with visible reduction in pore size

Origins Clear Improvement Face Mask offers a refreshing detox for your skin, effectively purging pores and leaving behind a revitalized complexion. Its charcoal-based formula deeply cleanses without over-drying, making it suitable for various skin types. It delivers noticeable results and is overall a solid choice for a weekly skincare ritual.

I use this one weekly to clear my pores. With work, I'm often outdoors and sweating, I get dirty or dusty or metal on me. I use this mask to clean and purify my pores. I haven't had break outs since using this.

As a user, I would rate the Clear Improvement® Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores 4.5 out of 5 stars. Here's why: Deep Cleansing: The active charcoal in the mask helps to draw out impurities and toxins from the skin, providing a deep cleanse that helps to unclog pores and minimize the appearance of blackheads and blemishes. Pore Refining: Regular use of the mask can help to refine the appearance of pores, leaving the skin looking smoother and more even-toned. This can result in a clearer complexion with fewer visible imperfections. Balanced Formula: The mask typically contains a balanced blend of ingredients that help to purify the skin without overly drying it out. This makes it suitable for a variety of skin types, including oily and combination skin. Easy Application: The mask is easy to apply and typically spreads smoothly over the skin. Many users find that a little goes a long way, so the 100 ml size offers good value for money. Quick Results: Users often report seeing results after just a few uses, with clearer, more radiant skin that feels smoother and more refined. Refreshing Sensation: The mask can provide a refreshing sensation when applied, leaving the skin feeling cool and invigorated. This makes it a pleasant addition to any skincare routine. Trusted Brand: Clear Improvement® is a well-known and trusted brand in the skincare industry, known for its effective products that deliver visible results

avis.titre: Nice clay mask that improves pores and skin texture
avis.texte: Formulated with Bamboo Charcoal and oil-absorbing Clay, this charcoal pore cleansing mask does more than deep clean. It helps draw out deep dwelling pore cloggers like impurities and debris, reduces excess oils that can lead to blemishes, and improves the appearance of skin's texture and pores.Plus, the clay absorbs oil and impurities within the pores. I highly recommend it.

Origins Clear Improvement Charcoal Mask. This Charcoal mask really helps detox your pores. I love Origins ingredients, they're cruelty free and vegan. This mask has really helped the texture of my combination skin. Would recommend!

I feel the negative reviews may be because people see any type of facial mask and assume a particular result automatically (this is what its for, what's expected)…whatever it is. I'm not sure. I believe this particular mask could be used to improve acne/ clean skin. I read the treatment is: Reduces Large Pores.🤷🏼‍♀️ANY-way.🤦🏼‍♀️ That's exactly what this mask did for me. I'am happy w: the product. My pores were reduced &&are disappearing I've used twice so far and seems fair to mention it is making a pretty noticeable difference. I do believe there's a possibility this product is NOT for all skin types. I have medium skin tone, I'm not prone to reactions and/ or sensitivity. I did notice in certain areas the product caused a burning sensation. I just assumed it was doing its thing; the burning subsided within minutes; and, did not leave an appearance of irritation or a burn behind. I did only apply a small amount to test my first time followed by only applying the product in areas my pores were enlarged (mainly on my cheeks, on my face.)
Its value for money and effective . Great for absorbing extra oil from skin and clean the pores . Its my fourth time buying this and i love using this .

I love this mouse it works really good. I normally use twice a week and put it on my face for about 10 minutes. Rinse off my face is super fresh, my blackheads, including and also it works pretty good with my acne face. I'll definitely buy them again.

avis.titre: My favorite mask for the past 10 years!
avis.texte: I was introduced to this mask 10 years ago with bad acne and this saved. My face is clear and smooth and has been ever since. I use this once a week and a little dot as a spot treatment and just as an overall face detox. I'd recommend this as a staple for anyone looking for clear skin.
It's good for the face I would definitely recommend and I really like how it has a nice set and it's really affordable for the price and can be used anytime of the day
Truly effective mask! Immediately calms my skin, and I can see get shrinking and healing right away! I highly recommend this for cleaning and clearing your skin!

So far I'm loving this. It doesn't dry me out. I use it only on my trouble some areas. It does not bother my sensitive skin at all. So far I've used it 2 times from the tube and there is still plenty left. If lasts months then it will be worth the price. Stay tuned.

I don't often notice a difference after a mask, especially sheet masks. But this spreadable, charcoal mask really made my skin clearer/smoother. Hardens on skin after about 10 minutes - some places weren't as tight so I left on a few more minutes. I would probably aim to use every other week.
The origins clear improvement active charcoal mask is a great occasional mask to use to help draw and clean pores. I find it gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin

Such a good face mask! I love how quick it dries, it truly takes no more than ten minutes to apply, dry, and take off with a wet/warm washcloth. It's really helped my skin clear and I love the convenience.

I dont even have sensitive skin and this product severely burned my face. I have a dark red outline where i applied the product and it feels like i have sunburn even after the mask was off. Ive never in my life had a reaction to a product like this
I use this maybe once every two weeks just to detox my skin from everything it's been exposed to and it always feels so refreshing.

The product did apply easily and it was tingly with a little burning sensation at first but once it started drying it burned so much. I rinsed it off and my whole face was bright pink red. I rinsed again and and the burning feeling is less but my face is still really red.

I've always struggled with acne and all the texture on my face and this has helped so much! I think it's the best face mask and a little goes a long way. It's smells good and small enough to travel with. Packaging.

avis.titre: Gave me a red rash and pimples
avis.texte: I do not recommend this product. It gave me a red rash for several days and itchy skin with small pimples forehead, cheeks and chin. I regret using this product and sad that I'm still dealing with the rash….ugh! So frustrating.
The best of the best for my skin! I have combinated, oily , problem skin, and it helps me to controle my acne. Use it every week and my skin looks better . Price very good for this quality
This makes me break out terribly every time I use it. It's a no from me.
I love this charcoal mask. I use it whenever my skin is breaking out or looks a little clogged. It really helps to clear up my complexion. It is not drying and leaves my skin feeling smooth.

Love this purifying charcoal mask. It's fantastic at really getting deeper dirt out of my pores and absorbing excess oils. Some masks like this will make my skin feel tight or dry after but this feels much more nourishing. Gifted by Origins US.

I use this as a spot treatment and as a mask. You get almost immediate results. I would definitley be prepared to moistrize after because it is a little drying but it does the job. Clears my breakouts overnight!

I have used this mask for years now and I love it, so my 15 year old daughter and 13 year old son both started to break out and when I noticed it getting bad I had them both give this a try twice a week in conjunction with their daily acne cleanser they had been using, well all I can say is that there is a reason I love this mask! Both kids saw results around the third week of use…. Less breakouts, faster overall healing and reduced scarring from the old acne spots. So needless to say this stuff is a staple in mine and my teenagers skin care routine. Definitely worth the price!

This always helps clear my pores out but I get those white heads that you can see under the surface of your skin (not the kind you can pop or pop themselves) and are hard to get rid of and I was hoping this would help but it didnt. It does however help with oil and blackheads so I DONT have to pop any blackheads. It doesnt dry me out or cause redness from harsh ingredients.

I actually couldn't believe the results within just the first use. This stuff is amazing, it is like a magnet for all the oil and gunk in your pores and it seriously leaves your pores looking so clean and small. I use this once weekly and it keeps my skin so clear. I will never stop using this and I 1000 percent recommend.

The word fun isn't used often in skincare routine, but I used this product with my niece as a little ritual. She helps me put on and then laughs because it is funny to see her aunt with face all muddled up. Then I can't laugh while waiting for it to dry. The peeling part is satisfying I can see all the black heads when peeling it.
It clears blackheads and also helps shrink larger pores, good product if you have these skin concerns. Also good if you have oily skin and want to improve it.

This mask got rid of those pesky little white bumps under my lip . I know you know what im talking about. Put this mask on for 15 minutes actaully 20 i forgot about it . Washed it out and they were gone .
It's okay can be drying at times, however, it does feel like it's cleaning the pores. Overall, it's a good product but nothing too crazy or skin changing.

avis.titre: My holy grail for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I'm not one to write reviews and I typically use facemasks for fun and don't expect results, but this one exceeded my expectations. I was getting frustrated that my skin was constantly breaking out so I decided to give this a try. This was the only thing I added into my skincare routine and once I did, my skin cleared! I use it twice a week on clean dry skin and leave it on for about 20 minutes. It can be drying so make sure you add a moisturizer or hydrating serum afterwards. I will continue purchasing!!
I very much liked this mask it was a close second to my glam and glow mud mask the drying experience isn't quite the same but it did leaving my skin feeling rejuvenated like the glam and glow did

This mask does wonders if you want to dry out some pimples for the next day but keep in mind that this is NOT a hydrating mask. Charcoal is really good for detox so this mask is good to use when you've been wearing a lot of sunscreen at the beach and want to detox your whole face, make sure you moisturize after though because it is drying.

avis.titre: worth it even though it's a little costly
avis.texte: I've used many masks in the past, and they've all dried out my skin. I did my research and wanted to try this brand out and I was not disappointed at all. A little expensive for the amount, but if you are able to afford it- it's worth it.

I got the mini side of this one as well and I'm definitely going back for the full size. I really loved them both! This one feels so good!! I've tried lots of charcoal masks and none of them are as good as this one. For having charcoal in it, it sure does make my skin look super moisturized, soft and glowy! It's not super drying & does the job. I have really acne prone skin and this not only helped, it didn't make it worse! Highly recommend!! (:

avis.titre: Prevents Breakouts & Great for Hormonal Acne
avis.texte: I use this mask once a week in order to prevent breakouts, and it has kept my skin super clear. I will also use it if I feel some acne and pimples coming in on the surface of my skin, and it takes the redness away almost immediately.

Like I said everything that they make is amazing and if you're on the fence about it just get it you will not regret it, and your skin will definitely thank you. Absolutely love everything they make. I don't know if it's because I'm a guy but I just recently ( 1 year) found out about this company and haven't used a product from them that I didn't love!!
Great for those who struggle with acne , especially the small ones. This helps to pull all of the impurities out of the face while not being harsh on your skin.

Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores is a purifying charcoal mask that unclogs pores for a perfectly pure look. It deeply detoxes, absorbs environmental toxins & dissolves impurities.
If you don't want to splurge on the glamglow mask, this mask is the perfect, dry skin friendly, alternative. I have travel size (minis) with me at all times when I travel.
I have used this mask a few times and I truly did not notice a big difference in my pores compared to other masks I have used. I have oily-combination skin

My skin was feeling really rough and bumpy after failing to stick to my skin care routine...so between using this mask and a few other fun Origins product from the Ginzing line and the Overnight mask (Drink Up Intensive -which I just slather on whenever) and drinking a TON of water, my skin was soft, supple, and glowing. Origins is amazing, I love all their products. Definitely recommend all their masks but this one is a real winner.

I've been breaking out badly in my neck and face since I delivered my baby in February. I used this last night and left it on for 45-60mins. I noticed that the mask had picked up a lot of the oil. Upon washing my face and neck I noticed a drastic difference in my skin. It looked cleaner and the acne was smaller and less red. I put Night-a-mins skin lotion on afterwards and went to bed. This morning I saw that my skin looked so fresh, hydrated, and the acne was almost all gone. Im so thankful I got my hands on this product again! I highly recommend this mask to anyone with acne skin issues.
I used to use this on the daily. Is there other affordable options? Yes but also I love this packaging and it doesn't get as messy as my others. You can really see it working too

I love this mask so much and received a sample from it a few years back and it blows any drug store charcoal mask out of the water! I use it after exfoliating or microdermabrasion and it's like the final touch of cleaning out those fresh new pores. It feels very firming on the skin so don't look to it for hydration. But if you want your pores clean, this is a game changer!!
This clay mask really helps minimize my pores. I use it mostly on my nose for black heads. It a dupe for another clay mast that when it dries it pulls out oil from your pores.
This is my holy grail face mask any time I feel like my face needs a deep cleanse! It clears my pores and leaves my face so clean and fresh! Def worth the buy!

I use this more consistently in the winter to help with my skin, but it is great to use year round. I've been using this for years and it's my absolute favorite. My skin always feels hydrated and clean after using it!
I have only used the mask twice but it has softened the skin on my cheeks and forehead. Broke my chin out in two spots but I have very sensitive skin so not too surprised. Will def keep using!

We have used this mask for awhile as a T zone and acne prone area mask as it has a great drying effect on the skin. My teens like to use it on stubborn acne as it will take away redness. Do not recommend as an all over as it's very drying.

Most charcoal masks have a tendency to be drying, which is why I'm a big fan of this nourishing option from Origins. It combines pore-purifying charcoal with honey (a humectant that draws in moisture to nourish and plump skin). Once you rinse it off, your skin will feel nice and clean, but not at all tight or dried out.

I initially purchased this mask to help with the blackheads on my nose and chin, and i cannot express in words how impressed I was with the results after the first use! My blackheads/pores had decreased and my skin felt so soft and clear. As someone with sensitive skin, this mask didn't seem to irritate it at all! I've been using it occasionally when my skin needs a little pick me up and I can say that it works for combination skin, my skin is super oily in the summer and all and very dry in the winter months and it works for both! The only downfall to this mask is that it can be drying, but with proper hydration it doesn't seem to be an issue.
I wanted to love this as much as I love the frothy face wash but it was way too strong for my sensitive skin and broke me out so bad, I returned it!

it's very bad i've never been prone to breakouts but i've used it twice in the past week and a half and i'm breaking out on both cheeks i wanted to write this review to say that i just used it two or so hours ago and i already have two new cystic pimples!! how does that even happen i'm very disappointed and will not be using again or purchasing from origins:(

I discovered this mask when I was about 17, and at 43 it's still the only mask I will ever use. I have combination skin, which is acne prone. EVERYTHING makes me break out. This mask makes my skin glow and does not make me break out. Using it about twice a month keeps my skin looking smooth and renewed. Big love for this product!

avis.titre: Did not notice much of a difference

I use this to exfoliate my face & clean my pores before I do my self tanning spray. I look good. I have normal skin with a dash of dry.

It does tingle a little when you first put it on, but oh my!!! My skin looks and feels amazing. I have super sensitive and dry skin. I used to use the city block clay exfoliating mask from Clinique, but they don't make it anymore. This is my new go to!
I've been using this for years and it always leads my Skin to a brighter and cleaner complexion. Love it and it pairs well with any highly moisture products

This product is fine. I didn't see any results from it, and after multiple uses, I felt it made me break out. I understand some products take time to get used to, but this doesn't seem worth the price!
This mask leaves my pores looking visibly smaller and my skin feeling soft. I like that it is not a peel off mask because it is much gentler on the skin while still cleansing my pores

Newer bottle seems a bit thinner than older versions but also just may be how long these last me (several years since I use only as needed).
The mask is good, I like the consistency. After applying it doesn't tighten your skin and leaves it smooth and soft. But do not expect any magic.
This mask is great for detoxifying the skin. I use it twice a week and it really controls the oil on my face. The price is good for the value of the product.
This product is pretty good ots not spectacular but I definitely see some improvement on my pore size and mt fave feels super clean after I use it
This mask is perfect "pick me up" for your skin. I use it 1-2 Times a week and it leaves me with a nice glow. This mask is a must have in my beauty routine.

I will say the glow boosting mask is definitely my FAVORITE from orgins!!! that one i have noticed helped my acne and instant results.
I love this mask, cleans and leaves my skin soft and smooth .. a little hard to wash off and dries quickly but it does the job, give it a try!

This mask is my absolute favorite and it keeps my skin from being red and irritated. Cleanses really deep into the pores; leaves the skin smooth
this charcoal mask is so good at what it does. my skin is always soft and glowing after I take it off, and the next day I can tell my pores are purified and unclogged and my skin feels truly clean.

This product has pushed my black head to the top I was very impressed about this yes I will continue to use this product it is doing the job on my face.

This product definitely make a change if you use it once or twice a week . This brand is also a good brand for the face and skin, been using for a while different ones same brand though . It's all due to your skin . Highly recommend

I love this mask! Been using it for years. It doesn't dry out my skin and leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed.

This is the only product that I use from this brand. It draws out impurities. It's unscented. It doesn't break the bank. I have easily gone through a handful of these bottles. Highly recommend!

kind of good, but i would say over priced for what it is i mean like it's pretty average. spa vibes tho which is fun but ya

This dries out my skin too much. Plus I do t get enough breaks outs to really get a good feeling on this product. It usually expires before I use it a second time.
I love using this when I need a deep clean! I was using a more expensive detox mask then tried a sample of this one and loved it more for a much lower price. I have repurchased many times!
I liked how my skin felt but only showed a difference in pores. My acne is hormonal prone it comes and goes, this helped a bit.

avis.titre: This is a really nice charcoal mask!
avis.texte: I received this is the best seller kit and I'm so glad I did. I used to use Younique skin care and they changed their formula, it wasn't as good. I thought I'd never find something comparable. I've been searching for a facial routine with natural ingredients and took a chance on Origins best seller kit. I'm so glad I did. I used this the first day I got it after the Checks and Balances face wash. I patted my skin with warm water as suggested to open pores and spread this on, let dry (it'll feel tight, it's supposed to) and rinsed off, a total of 10-12 minutes. It left my skin so clean, my pores looked smaller, gentle, but so effective. I could see the difference from the toxins and impurities washing out with this mask. After this I used the mushroom resilience toner, followed by the multi powered youth serum, followed by the ginseng gel moisturizer. You'll love this, once a week, at least and you'll see a difference. I'm obsessed with all the products in the kit! I've already ordered more.

I love using this about once every few weeks to clear out any congestion from the days. I work at home now so I'm not exposed to the environment as often but when I was I would use it once a week. I recommend it to people all the time

avis.titre: Ahhh... just what my skin needed
avis.texte: Ahhh... just what my skin needed. Glad I snagged this up, my dirty little pores needed a spring cleaning and this product did the job.

avis.titre: possibly one of the best masks i've tried
avis.texte: i waited to write this review until i had used this mask a few times regularly to see how it affected my skin after using it more than once. i can definitely tell you to just buy it if you have clogged pores, blackheads, acne, etc. my skin feels so clean and it doesn't feel like it's just drying your skin out like some other wash-off masks i've tried. it also doesn't make my skin feel irritated or angry after. when it's dry it doesn't flake off or anything so you don't have to worry about making a mess while your waiting. i found that it's a bit hard to wash off but it doesn't really take that long. there's a lot of product in the tube too, it might not be a huge tube but i've used it quite a few times now on my whole face and still have barely even made a dent.
my skin is a little dry and my nose and chin get black heads, i tried this and noticed a difference after i used it. made my skin really soft after as well.

Had trouble with pretty severe acne during the beginning of the pandemic when I started wearing a mask/ face shield (required at my job). I hadn't changed anything in my skin care routine to have made my face go crazy. I was already using the checks and balances frothy face wash and was recommended this face mask. It made my skin feel very tight after using it which caused my acne to break open. I haven't tried this face mask again after getting my acne under control, but was not impressed while I struggled with acne. Would not purchase again. Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask Clear Pores 0.5 Oz Trial Size
I like everything about this mask. With my hormonal acne, this mask really helps. I alternate this mask with several others, as needed. A little goes a long way.
I really wanted to love this. However, it has not cleared my pores at all. It did nothing to my skin but leave it shiny. That's not what I was expecting from it :(
I use this mask once a month and afterwards I get so many compliments on how my skin looks glows. I serious do not understand all the negative reviews. This facial mask is absolutely magical
This is my go-to mask when I have breakouts and redness! It helps calm down my irritated skin! Very good price point, a little goes a long way!
I have repurchased this many times because it is that good! Great for exfoliating and leaves your skin so fresh after!!!
I use this one whenever my skin needs a reset. It's easy to use and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean. Would definitely repurchase.
I use this for clearing breakouts. It doesn't dry my skin but help reduce acne. It is pretty gentle, so I recommend it if you have sensitive skin.
I love this charcoal mask it makes my skin feel fresh and clean and soft but it's very hard to wash off the skin.but it's worth the effort
I love charcoal masks and after going through what feels like all of them, I have finally found the one. I will never use another mask, this one got rid of my acne overnight!

This is great for hormonal acne and breakouts. It has a thick consistency but it isn't too heavy. I did notice that it made my skin a little red but I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate it or cause any more breakouts.
I absolutely love this charcoal mask from Origins. It helps your skin in removing dirt and oil and also helps to even your skin tone and reduce breakouts.
This mask works really great and made my skin feel amazing! It definitely helped my pores and made my skin glow. It is a little messy though since it's black.
This is fast reacting. And works well for my oily t zones. You can feel it pulling out dirt and oils that cleansers can't. It's relaxing and you can see the effect right away.
Super detoxifying mask that doesn't dry your skin out. Perfect for all skin types and even sensitive skin. Helps with acne and blemishes.
Felt nice, but not sure if it did anything for me. Did feel a little tight afterwards. Did not irritate my skin at all, which some masks do.
I liked this, it was a great mask; but it just dried out my face, didn't feel like there was much added benefits to it afterwards. I feel like i've tried others that i like more.
Love this product for breakouts! Face feels really clean and smooth after washing this off. Recommend this product to everyone!
This guy is a staple in my mask stash. My skin feels ah-mazing and cleaned out after use. I've recommended it to many friends & family
This is a wonderful product and I would highly recommend it. It is well worth the purchase and is one of the best products out there
This mask makes my skin feel great and helps reduce blackheads. Smells great and easy to use. I would use this every other day
Great product for deep cleaning and toning the skin. Helps to unclog pores and soak up excess oil. I highly recommend if you have oily skin.
it was difficult to squeeze from the bottle but was a really effective mask during my acne probe days and never irritated my skin
While I've moved away from loving clay masks in general, I still enjoy this one from time to time. I use it on my T-zone and it helps with the oil production.
If you are a fan of charcoal this is a good make. Definitely expect for your skin to purge it'll clear up though just getting the nasties outb

Isn't the best charcoal mask I've used. Its definitely good for its price point and is gentle enough for everyday use. The smell isn't too strong and a little goes a long way. This was a staple for me growing up because I liked how it made the skin feel but is not a skin saver for last minute acne. Good if you're looking for a gentle mask though. I am indifferent and most likely will not purchase again.
This is a good mask overall but i did not see much if a difference with clearing my pores. It feels good on the face and it does not dry out my skin.
Enjoyable mask. Its the most common charcoal mask that I use. It isn't too harsh. I enjoy this brand a lot. I will continue to purchase this.

avis.titre: Great mask, a little goes a long way
avis.texte: This mask is great, it always leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. A little goes a long way so the tube is a good investment but if you aren't sure I believe there are smaller tubes for sale to try it out and see if it works for your skin.
This mask is great especially if you have very oily skin . It draws up all the impurities and leaves your skin so smooth and fresh . Great addition to your skincare regimen.
This product is great when I'm suffering a breakout or dealing with pore congestion! My skin is so soft, clean and refreshed. The ingredients are gentle, yet effective. This brand is amazing.
This definitely helps with oils control and any breakouts that may pop up. I use this every so often! Definitely suggest this of you combo/oily skin

This is a very good face mask. Charcoal is great at absorbing the skins oils to help prevent breakouts and combat acne. The ingredients are pretty natural so I like that but there isn't anything super special about this product compared to other charcoal masks!
I like this , I think there is def better options out there but this is not bad by any means ! It kind of burns a bit but I do feel clean after I wash this off !

For the first time in my life, I need a little help with the pores on and around my nose. I've used this product one time, and I immediately saw a difference. If these results continue, I'll be buying this product again.
Nothing spectacular and won't actually get rid of black heads but not bad

Every time I've used this I've ended up with multiple cystic pimples (which I never get) within 1-2 days. My skin looks awful right now, through the bottle away this morning. I love Origins but this is not the product for me.

I LOVE this product. I use it once a week and it makes a super noticeable difference with my pores and overall quality of my skin. I like to first derma-plane my face, apply the mask, rinse, and moisturizer really well. The next day my skin always looks amazing. I can definitely tell if I miss a week. My pores get bigger, more acne forms, more discoloration, etc.

Great product . A little goes a long way for this mask. It feels refreshing and clean Once it dries you feel the detox process occurring . Will be trying the charcoal avocado mask for a more hydrating experience.
i love it!! first 2 or 3 uses it brought everything up so i had some breakouts, after use number 5 my skin was clear. honestly don't plan on using any other face wash unless it's this one

I love this mask. Anytime I'm struggling with breakouts I can use this and my skin always feels and looks better by the next morning. It doesn't burn or cause irritation, I have sensitive skin. This has been my favorite acne mask for years!

Only 2 stars because of my skin. But I've used this mask other times before and noticed pimples rise after rinsing. I have a very clear face but use the mask for just the little black/whiteheads i have. I've noticed it leaves my skin worse more than clear and gives me underneath pimples :( which i never have face pimples so it's strange seeing them pop up.

I have oily/combination skin. Currently, I am dealing with a lot of hormonal acne around my chin and neck. I like to check out new masks. I received this product as a free sample on an Ulta purchase a couple of months ago. There was a concern of having a reaction so I did a patch test on my neck. There wasn't any reaction regarding bringing up more acne or irritations. The texture of my mask is very smooth and kinda oily but I'm not sure. There are no added fragrances which are always great. But the smell of the products is not very pleasant for me. I'm not sure about it, I have only used it once. I'm not sure if it will add anything new to my current skincare routine.

avis.titre: I've used this for years, still my go to mask!
avis.texte: I've been using this mask as a teenager and still years later it's my go to mask. I have sensitive skin but it doesn't leave my skin dry or itchy. My skin feels smooth and supple afterwards. Add it to your beauty routine now!

I didn't have any whiteheads or blackheads on my face. After applying , it burnt my face and after few days I saw many whiteheads appeared on my skin. I applied the mask again after a week hoping to eradicate whiteheads but it didn't disappear at all. I am seeing a strange phenomenon by using a reputable product.

avis.titre: The only thing I dislike is the texture
avis.texte: I like how it makes my skin feel after using it! I feel super clean and smooth. I read some recent reviews about this breaking people out, and while I haven't had any issues so far I'm a little hesitant to try it more than once every 1.5-2 weeks. As for the texture, it feels a bit strange (a bit oily maybe?) but the feeling doesn't last after it's been washed off. Overall, I did have a positive experience with this mask and would consider repurchasing in the future!
Works well to clean pores. Not a mask fan but works great for mornings after I don't take off my makeup.

Ive used bottles of this throughout my mask wearing and it helped control my mask acne. It was a MIRACLE. Recently I ran out of it and my face started breaking out again so I bought a new bottle. Unfortunately my cystic mask acne is not going away now. The product seems to go on thinner than it used to and it dries quicker. So I wonder if there was possibly a change in the product.
I love this product! It works like a charm, always clearing away oiliness and dirt. I've used other charcoal and clay type masks and they are much less effective and unreliable. Recommended.
It's good but you don't see the results the first time you use it. Apply every other day to see results.

avis.titre: Burns and stings horribly, and skin is irritated afterwards
avis.texte: This mask burns horribly when it goes on and leaves skin super irritated. It hurts! I do not recommend :(

I used this mask when my skin type was different a few years ago. I'm hoping that the ingredients haven't changed much but the stuff in this bottle is not what I used a few years ago! My skin has now developed congested pores ever since I started using it again. Never will I go back to this mask.
Works great to help clear pores. Leaves skin feeling clean and purified. Made my skin bright and feel smooth. I use a skin spatula to apply and let it dry and than wash off. Very easy to use.
I have dry skin and this is the only charcoal mask that doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. Leaves my skin feeling deeply cleansed. I follow this up with a hyaluronic acid serum and moisturizer.
My skin felt extra clean but this mask caused my acne to flare up and little bumps too. I must be allergic.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I love this product so much! I love how much my skin feels after I use this. I feel refreshed and my skin has such a youthful glow. I will recommend this product again and again ♥️
I got this in my Ipsy bag this month and was super excited to try it. Within about a minute my face was burningggg and now it's red.
I use a very small amount of this mask on my face 2x a week and can definitely see a difference in my pores. My acne and blackhead situation has gotten alot better. I recommend!
This will always be a favorite of mine!! Buy it, you won't regret it!

I've used this product for years and after a one year hiatus, I just bought a new tube. After using it, my face was burning, red, and very very bumpy. The itchiness has stopped after a few days but my skin is still just as bumpy for almost a week now. I used to use this product 3/4 times a week no problem and raved about how good it was. What happened?

Best mask I've tried so far. Tightens and brightens skin instantly. It says to rinse, but I use a hot wash cloth, let it sit on skin several minutes then repeat until it's all off. Skin feels soft, smooth and glows instantly. I'd buy this again.

Although I love the brand and it's intention to help with the environment, their other products sensitize and irritate my skin because of all the fragrance. This product is straight forward with no essential oils to irritate my skin.

I've used a ridiculous amount of different masks just because I like trying different ones. But this is IT. It's the only face mask that I've actually seen results! First Origins product I ever used. Now, I swear by ALL Origins products!!!

avis.titre: Does amazing things for the pores
avis.texte: I love to use this mask once a week to really give my pores a good cinching. The mask itself is really light weight but the results are doing all the heavy lifting.
Looking for a cheaper dupe of the Glamglow charcoal mask and this one did the trick. Left my skin super soft!

I've used this product before and loved it! Could usually see a difference in my pores before and after but this time the only difference is that my entire face is red, bumpy, and swollen. I've been wracking my brain all day trying to figure out what happened and after reading similar reviews of this mask and seeing photos that look almost exactly like mine I think I've narrowed it down! I used this mask for the dozenth time last night after having bought a new tube (because again, I loved it so much before and I ran out) so I didn't think it could possibly be the cause. As one other person on here said, you can literally see the line on my jaw of where it was and wasn't applied. Really hoping this doesn't last for weeks! My face is itchy and dry. I work very hard researching brands and trying to find only the best, most natural and safe products for my skin, it would be such a shame for all of that to go away.
